user.description: Sets up Israel Transit and builds a local copy of the Ministry of Transport timetable, which downloads about 150 MB once. You then add your stops one by one.

abort.already_configured: Israel Transit is already set up. Add stops with the "Add stop" button on its page.

user.title: Find a stop
user.description: Pick one of the stops nearest your home, when your home location is set, or search by stop name, city and street, or by the code printed on the stop sign. Words combine, so "Kfar Saba Weizmann" narrows to that street. A search takes priority over a stop picked from the list.

settings.title: Stop settings
settings.description:
{stop}

Choose which lines get their own sensors. Leave empty to track the stop as a whole.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh. Real-time data comes from a free community service, so please keep this at 60 seconds or more. When nothing is due for a while, at night or on Shabbat, it refreshes less often by itself.
data_description.walk_minutes: Minutes from your door to the stop. Adds a "Leave by" sensor and lets the "Time to leave" trigger and the card tell you when to head out. 0 turns it off.
data_description.rail_destination: Only for railway stations. Israel Railways reports departure delays per route, so a destination is needed to show live train times instead of the timetable.

progress.building_index: Building the local timetable from the Ministry of Transport feed. This downloads about 150 MB and runs once.

get_arrivals.name: Get arrivals
get_arrivals.description: Returns the upcoming arrivals at a stop: each line with its destination, the minutes until it arrives, whether the time is live or from the timetable, its delay in minutes, and cancellations. The response also carries a ready-to-read summary sentence, how many minutes are left to leave home when the stop has a walking time, and, when nothing is due at night or on Shabbat, when service resumes.

stop_code.name: Stop code
stop_code.description: The Ministry of Transport stop code printed on the stop sign, for example 21023.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: Only these line numbers, for example 18 or 480. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

rail_destination.name: Train destination
rail_destination.description: Israel Railways destination station ID, for example 3700 for Tel Aviv Savidor Center. Gives live train departures and delays instead of the timetable.

notify_arrival.name: Notify me when it's close
notify_arrival.description: Sends one notification to a phone when the next vehicle of a line is a few minutes, or a few stops, away from a stop. Vehicles already that close when you set it are skipped. Without a target it goes to the Home Assistant app on the phones of the user who set it. Lasts up to two hours and does not survive a restart.

stop_code.name: Stop code
stop_code.description: The Ministry of Transport stop code printed on the stop sign.

line.name: Line
line.description: The line number to watch, for example 18.

minutes.name: Minutes before
minutes.description: Notify when the vehicle is due within this many minutes. Defaults to 5, or to 1 when a number of stops is set.

stops.name: Stops before
stops.description: Notify when the vehicle is this many stops away. Needs the vehicle's live position; without one, the minutes apply.

notify_entity_id.name: Send to
notify_entity_id.description: Notify entities to send to. Leave empty for your own phones in the Home Assistant app.

cancel_arrival_alert.name: Cancel arrival notification
cancel_arrival_alert.description: Cancels a notification set with "Notify me when it's close" for the same stop, line and recipients. Cancelling one that already went off does nothing.

stop_code.name: Stop code
stop_code.description: The Ministry of Transport stop code printed on the stop sign.

line.name: Line
line.description: The line number the notification was set for.

notify_entity_id.name: Send to
notify_entity_id.description: The same recipients the notification was set with. Leave empty for your own phones.

refresh_stop.name: Refresh stop
refresh_stop.description: Fetches a stop's arrivals now instead of waiting for its next update.

search_stops.name: Search stops
search_stops.description: Searches the Ministry of Transport stops by name, city, street or code.

query.name: Search
query.description: Words to search for, or a stop code.

rebuild_timetable.name: Rebuild timetable
rebuild_timetable.description: Downloads the Ministry of Transport timetable again and rebuilds the local copy. Takes a few minutes and about 150 MB.

arrival.name: Line arrives at a stop
arrival.description: Triggers when a vehicle reaches a stop, or a set time before or after it does. Follows the live time as it changes, and fires once per trip.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: How long before or after the arrival to trigger. Zero triggers at the arrival itself.

offset_type.name: Before or after
offset_type.description: Whether the offset is before the arrival or after it.

leave.name: Time to leave for the stop
leave.description: Triggers when it is time to leave home to catch a vehicle: its arrival minus the stop's walking time, or a set time before that. Follows the live time and fires once per trip. With no walking time set, it fires at the arrival.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

offset.name: Heads-up
offset.description: How long before the time to leave to trigger. Zero triggers at the moment to leave.

delay.name: Vehicle delayed
delay.description: Triggers once per trip when a vehicle is reported late by at least the given number of minutes. Delays are reported for trains with a destination set.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line or train number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

min_delay.name: Minimum delay
min_delay.description: Trigger once the delay reaches this many minutes.

is_arriving_within.name: Vehicle arriving within
is_arriving_within.description: Tests if a vehicle, of one line or any, is due at the stop within the given number of minutes.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How soon the vehicle has to be due.

is_realtime_available.name: Real-time is available
is_realtime_available.description: Tests if the stop's times are live rather than from the timetable.
